# SOP-P2-L1-03 First-article inspection - Hot Forge line

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-RR01, EQ-P2-L1-IH02, EQ-P2-L1-SB03  
Related documents: SB-1001, SOP-P2-L1-01, SOP-P2-L1-02

Purpose
1. Establish the controlled process for first-article inspection (FAI) on the Hot Forge line to verify tooling, machine set-up, material condition, and part conformance prior to resuming production. Background, rationale, examples, and required records are provided to support repeatable, auditable inspections.

Scope
2. Applies to all first-article runs on P2-L1 where new or revised tooling, material lot change, or equipment maintenance has occurred on EQ-P2-L1-RR01, EQ-P2-L1-IH02, or EQ-P2-L1-SB03.

Preconditions
3. Work area must be cleared of non-essential materials and obstructions; material lot and travel documents must be present. Confirm system alarms are cleared and permit-to-work or lockout documentation from maintenance is attached if maintenance occurred. Reference SOP-P2-L1-02 for pre-start mechanical checks and SOP-P2-L1-01 for general line start requirements.

Personal protective equipment (PPE)
4. Minimum PPE for FAI personnel: steel-toe footwear, heat-resistant gloves, long-sleeve cotton coveralls, face shield, hearing protection, and safety glasses. Use respiratory protection per SB-1001 when shot blast cabinet access or dust exposure is anticipated.

Critical process values (to be observed, exact values recorded)
5. The dust collector pressure drop alarm for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03) is 1240 Pa. Monitor and log the dust collector pressure differential reading prior to and after shot blast activity; do not proceed if the alarm condition is present.
6. The target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) is 1180 °C. Measure and log billet surface temperature using calibrated instruments; ensure measured value is at or consistent with target before forging operations commence.

Step-by-step procedure
7. Verify administrative preconditions:
   - Confirm relevant traveler and engineering drawing are present at the cell.
   - Confirm material lot and heat code match the traveler.
   - Confirm tooling identification and serial numbers match the control plan.

8. Equipment status verification:
   - Inspect EQ-P2-L1-RR01 for visible damage or obstruction of feed and return paths.
   - Verify EQ-P2-L1-IH02 control panel indicates ready and instrumentation is calibrated per plant calibration records.
   - Confirm EQ-P2-L1-SB03 blast cabinet doors and interlocks function; verify dust collector pre-start indicators.

9. Environmental and utility checks:
   - Confirm compressed air and electrical supply indications are within normal operating parameters (visual check of gauges and panel indicators only).
   - Verify area ventilation is operational; reference SB-1001 for dust and ventilation control requirements.

10. Material preparation and heater confirmation:
   - Stage the first billet from the approved lot.
   - Using the calibrated pyrometer or thermocouple, measure the billet temperature at the recommended location per engineering drawing and record the measurement. The target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) is 1180 °C. If reading is not consistent with target, follow hold-for-inspection and escalate to engineering.

11. Run a controlled first feed to the roll and forge stations:
   - Feed the first billet into EQ-P2-L1-RR01 and observe feed alignment, bite, and any abnormal vibrations. Pause the line on any abnormal condition.
   - Monitor and log the die fill, flash formation, and part transfer. Capture one representative sample for dimensional inspection.

12. Shot blast and surface finish verification:
   - After forging and trimming, process the sample through EQ-P2-L1-SB03 shot blast cabinet for surface preparation. The dust collector pressure drop alarm for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03) is 1240 Pa; check the differential prior to shot blast, and after, and document both readings.
   - Inspect blasted surface for uniformity, embedded media, and acceptable cleanliness per engineering drawing.

13. Dimensional and visual inspection:
   - Perform full FAI dimensional checks and visual acceptance criteria on the sample per drawing and control plan. Record all measured features and any nonconformances on the FAI form.
   - If dimensions are within the drawing requirements and visual inspection is acceptable, proceed to produce a minimum verification sample quantity as required by the control plan and document those pieces.

14. Nonconformance and hold procedure:
   - If any critical dimension or process alarm condition occurs, stop the line, notify production supervision and quality engineering, and place affected material on hold.
   - Initiate disposition per plant nonconformance procedures and reference SOP-P2-L1-01 for stop-and-hold criteria.

Records to keep
15. For each FAI event retain:
   - Completed FAI inspection form with part number and revision (as applicable).
   - Equipment status checklist for EQ-P2-L1-RR01, EQ-P2-L1-IH02, EQ-P2-L1-SB03.
   - Temperature log showing billet measurement and instrument ID.
   - Dust collector differential readings before and after shot blast.
   - Photos of tooling set-up and representative parts (frontal, side, and critical feature close-ups).
   - Calibration certificates for measurement instruments used.
   - Any nonconformance reports and dispositions.

Examples and rationale
16. Example: if billet temperature reads 1170 °C and target is 1180 °C, hold the run and consult engineering — forging at a lower temperature can increase forging forces and increase the risk of die wear and internal defects. The target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) is 1180 °C; recording the actual measurement supports root-cause analysis if defects appear.
17. Example: if dust collector differential reaches or exceeds the alarm setpoint, e.g., the system shows the alarm state associated with 1240 Pa, stop shot blasting and inspect filters and media containment. The dust collector pressure drop alarm for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03) is 1240 Pa; logging both pre- and post-blast readings demonstrates adequate housekeeping and filter performance.

Sign-off
18. Completion sign-off requires signatures from:
   - Production lead (verifies tooling and equipment set-up).
   - Quality engineer (verifies dimensional and visual acceptance).
   - Maintenance lead (confirms equipment cleared after any maintenance).
   - Records sign-off must reference this document id and related documents: SB-1001, SOP-P2-L1-01, SOP-P2-L1-02.

Revision control and retention
19. Maintain FAI records in the document control system under this document id for the period specified by corporate retention policy. Reference related documents SB-1001, SOP-P2-L1-01, and SOP-P2-L1-02 for additional requirements and cross-checks.
